scan_pyarrow_dataset: scan a pyarrow dataset and return a polars LazyFrame for lazy evaluation
scan_pyarrow_dataset_cloud: scan a partitioned cloud dataset stored in s3 using pyarrow dataset with ipc format
scan_pyarrow_dataset_filter: scan a pyarrow dataset and push down predicates to pyarrow for filtered column selection
scan_pyarrow_dataset_batch: scan a pyarrow dataset with a custom batch size to control record batch row counts
scan_pyarrow_dataset_partitioned: scan a partitioned pyarrow dataset ensuring partition columns are passed to polars
